Question: David, Hikmet, Jack, Marta, Rand, and Todd were in a \(12\)-person race with \(6\) other people. Rand finished \(6\) places ahead of Hikmet. Marta finished \(1\) place behind Jack. David finished \(2\) places behind Hikmet. Jack finished \(2\) places behind Todd. Todd finished \(1\) place behind Rand. Marta finished in \(6\)th place. Who finished in \(8\)th place?
